title: SREV-008 token default DACL mutation shape

default_dacl_shape.description: TOKEN_DEFAULT_DACL.DefaultDacl is the default ACL assigned to objects created by the token user; GetTokenInformation(TokenDefaultDacl) may return DefaultDacl == NULL when the token has no default DACL

acl_opacity.description: ACL is opaque to applications; ACL must be built via documented APIs (InitializeAcl, AddAce, AddAccessAllowedAce) rather than editing AclSize directly

size_info_shape.description: GetAclInformation(AclSizeInformation) returns AceCount, AclBytesInUse, AclBytesFree; AddAccessAllowedAce returns failure when the ACE cannot fit (ERROR_ALLOTTED_SPACE_EXCEEDED)

new_buffer_topology.description: RunSandboxedSetDacl builds a new ACL in an independent HeapAlloc buffer: GetAclInformation sizing -> InitializeAcl on new buffer -> GetAce/AddAce copy existing ACEs -> AddAccessAllowedAce caller ACE -> SetTokenInformation with rebuilt ACL

failure_topology.description: DefaultDacl == NULL fails closed with ERROR_INVALID_ACL; NewAclSize > 0xFFFF fails closed with ERROR_ALLOTTED_SPACE_EXCEEDED; HeapAlloc failure fails closed with ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY; every InitializeAcl/GetAce/AddAce/AddAccessAllowedAce return is checked

policy_invariant.description: Caller SID selection (useUserSID vs LogonSid) and access-mask policy are unchanged

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: MSI/service custom-action launch still grants the intended caller access

contracts: TOKEN_DEFAULT_DACL.DefaultDacl may be NULL and must be gated before ACL API calls
ACL structure must be opaque; no code writes pAcl->AclSize
GetAclInformation(AclRevisionInformation) supplies the ACL revision for the rebuilt ACL
InitializeAcl, GetAce, AddAce, and AddAccessAllowedAce return values are checked
SetTokenInformation(TokenDefaultDacl) receives the rebuilt ACL only after the new ACE is added successfully
Old ACL remains readable while ACEs are copied into the new buffer
